Don't Let Go (David Sneddon song) | "Don't Let Go" is a pop song, written by musician, singer and songwriter David Sneddon and Scott MacAlister, and released as a single on 21 April 2003 where it reached No.3 in the UK Singles Chart.  It was the second single and follow up to his debut number-one hit, "Stop Living the Lie".
